meta_title: Camp life — coins, quests, Friday programme and life in camp
description: The Lord of the Rings 2026 is not only the Saturday battle. Come already on Thursday or Friday and live camp life in Middle-earth: coins, trade, small quests, the Friday game, faction camp and a programme for young adventurers.
title: Camp life
subtitle: Come earlier. Middle-earth begins in the camp.
intro_p1: The Lord of the Rings isn’t just the Saturday battle. We want the campsite to turn into a piece of Middle-earth from the moment you arrive — with its own atmosphere, armies, fires, trade, song, small games, services, quests and encounters. For 2026 we’re preparing several new things to support play outside the main battle.
h_60s: The most important things in 60 seconds
s60_l1: Each participant gets a number of in-game coins at registration.
s60_l2: Coins can be used for small games, bets, services, trade and atmospheric play in camp.
s60_l3: We want the campsite to be more divided by armies and sides.
s60_l4: Friday will be devoted to play in camp, the side programme, arenas, capture-the-flag and the children’s game.
s60_l5: Micro personal quests and small tasks will appear.
s60_l6_pre: For children we’re preparing a separate
s60_l7_strong: None of this will work without you.
s60_l7_post: Camp life only happens if you actually want to play.
news1_desc: Games, bets, services, trade. Coins bring camp life alive.
news2_desc: A dividing line between the light and dark sides. Armies together.
news3_desc: A team game in camp. Shorter format, suitable for newcomers too.
news4_desc: Trade, bards, mercenaries, fortune-tellers. The best things will come from you.
news5_desc: Small tasks: deliver a message, win a bet, find a person.
news6_desc: A separate programme for children aged 5–9. Their own adventure.
mince_p1: Each participant will receive a number of in-game coins at the start of the event. We are preparing several types of coins so they fit different peoples and races of Middle-earth.
mince_p2: By default we count on a simple 1:1 rate between the coin types. But Middle-earth isn’t an accountant’s spreadsheet. It will be up to you whether you keep this rate or start creating your own value, agreements and trading customs among yourselves.
mince_use_intro: Coins are mainly meant to support camp life. You can use them for example:
mince_l3: for bets on arenas and tournaments,
mince_use_note: Want firewood for the fire? Hire someone to help. Want bards by your fire? Even bards don’t live on glory alone. Want to try archery in the elven camp? It might cost something. Want to order a night watch? Mercenaries also have their worldly needs.
mince_pub_p_pre: We also count on the option of using coins as a game element in arrangement with the
mince_pub_p_post: . We’ll specify the exact conditions and scope of use later.
mince_alert_title: Coins are not an official currency
mince_alert_strong: are not normal money or a claimable discount
mince_alert_post: . They are game items meant to enliven camp life. Their use at the inn, with organisers or in specific activities will be governed by the agreement and rules of the event.
mince_h_more: How do I get more coins
mince_more_intro: Each participant gets the basic number of coins on registration on site. You can earn more for example:
mince_more_l2: by taking part in arenas, tournaments and games,
mince_more_l3: by offering services to other players,
mince_more_l5: by helping the organisers with preparation,
mince_more_l6: through your own creativity and engagement in camp life.
tab_p1: In recent years the campsite has changed substantially. Historical tents, themed shelters and period camps have multiplied so much that they are no longer just a small extra somewhere on the edge of the meadow.
tab_p2: At the same time we keep hearing from groups, lords and commanders that they want to be together with their army. They want a shared fire, to talk things over, play camp life, drill and create the atmosphere of their side.
tab_p3_pre: That’s why we want to divide the campsite for 2026 more by armies and sides. The dividing path / line will naturally run between the
tab_l1: Armies and groups should have a better chance to camp together.
tab_l2: The camp will turn more into a play space.
tab_l3: It will be easier to play faction life.
tab_l4: Period and themed tents will still be welcome.
tab_l5: We recommend masking modern tents as much as possible with tarps, fabric or non-distracting placement.
tab_l6: If you can buy or borrow a historical tent, it will help the atmosphere a lot.
tab_alert: This year we want to see the camp as part of the game. It’s not just where you sleep. It’s about creating the feeling of an army camp in Middle-earth from the moment of arrival.
vl_p1: Friday won’t just be waiting for the Saturday battle. We want there to be play already on Friday.
vl_p2: We are preparing a Friday game in camp, including capture-the-flag and other side activities. The goal isn’t to create a second main battle — the goal is to get the camp moving, involve the armies, support the atmosphere and give participants a reason to arrive earlier.
vl_l1: a simple team game in or around the camp,
vl_l4: a shorter format than the Saturday battle,
vl_l5: emphasis on movement, cooperation and atmosphere,
vl_l6: no need to know the whole Saturday scenario.
vl_note: Exact rules, times and the way to take part will be added during June.
z_p1: Camp life isn’t just organiser-run activities. The best things often happen between participants.
z_intro: We want to support you to:
z_l8: play your character outside the battlefield too.
z_i1: a dwarven tap by the fire,
z_i11: a scribe of contracts and bets.
z_box_title: I want to take part but don’t know how
z_box_l5: join in a game or arena,
z_box_l7: don’t be afraid to start with something small.
q_p1: We are also preparing small personal quests. They aren’t meant to replace the main game. They are meant to add atmosphere and give participants small reasons to interact.
ki_p1_pre: For younger children we are preparing a separate children’s game. It’s mainly for children roughly aged
ki_p1_post: , up to about 10. Younger children can only join with a parent.
ki_p2: The children’s game will run on Thursday, Friday and Saturday. On Friday it will mainly be games, workshops and activities on the meadow and in the forest. On Saturday during the main battle we’re preparing a station-based game, tasks and a treasure adventure.
end_h: Come earlier. There will be play.
end_p1: We believe there are plenty of new things. And we hope you’re looking forward to them as much as we are.
end_p2: At the same time we know not everything has to be perfect on the first try. Camp life doesn’t happen because an organiser writes about it on the website. It happens because people start to play.
end_p3: So come, take part, trade, sing, bet, negotiate, offer services, take on tasks and build Middle-earth with us. Without you it will just be a meadow. With you it can be the camp of armies before the great battle.
footnote: Some details (number of coins, exact scope of the Friday game, contact person for camp RP) will be added during June based on current organisational preparation.
tab_alert_rental: No historical tent of your own? No worries. We have a few tents available for rent. If you’re interested, write to us at info@panprstenu.cz.
